*Upādānadukādi, Sanidassanattika* (Patthana 21.53) is an analytical section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and concluding treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka in the Pali Canon. Structurally, the text investigates conditional relations by cross-combining dyads beginning with clinging (*upādānaduka-ādi*) with the triad concerning states with visibility and resistance (*sanidassanattika*).
